questions.question_prompt: What is a dangerous effect of stimulant drugs on driving?
questions.keyed_answer: Overconfidence while fatigue may be masked.
questions.keyed_answer_explanation: Feeling stimulated does not mean judgement and reaction are safe.
questions.baseline_gap_reason: Stimulant drugs masking fatigue and producing overconfidence are not explained.
questions.required_teaching_claim: Explain masked fatigue and overconfidence from stimulant drugs; distinguish feeling alert from safe judgement.
questions.source_route: R-DRUGS provides background; exact combined claim pending, then Läkemedelsverket if needed.

questions.question_prompt: What is microsleep in driving?
questions.keyed_answer: A brief unintended episode of sleep.
questions.keyed_answer_explanation: Even a very brief loss of awareness can cover a substantial distance at road speed.
questions.baseline_gap_reason: Microsleep is not defined.
questions.required_teaching_claim: Define brief unintended sleep and show distance travelled during a short lapse.
questions.source_route: Agency search first; R-FATIGUE/VTI report as proposed official fallback. Exact definition pending.

questions.question_prompt: What is the fundamental remedy for sleep deprivation?
questions.keyed_answer: Adequate sleep.
questions.keyed_answer_explanation: Temporary alertness measures do not replace restorative sleep.
questions.baseline_gap_reason: Fatigue and stopping/rest planning are covered, but restorative sleep as the remedy for sleep deprivation is not taught.
questions.required_teaching_claim: Explain that adequate sleep addresses sleep deprivation; transient alertness does not replace sleep.
questions.source_route: Agency search first; R-SLEEP fallback.

questions.question_prompt: What is the central aim of Vision Zero?
questions.keyed_answer: No one should be killed or seriously injured in road traffic.
questions.keyed_answer_explanation: The approach includes safer roads, vehicles and behaviour while recognising human mistakes.
questions.baseline_gap_reason: Vision Zero and its no-death/no-serious-injury goal are not defined.
questions.required_teaching_claim: Define Vision Zero's no-death/no-serious-injury aim and connect it to driver choices.
questions.source_route: R-ZERO.

questions.question_prompt: What is the safety purpose of a correctly adjusted head restraint?
questions.keyed_answer: To reduce damaging head movement in a collision.
questions.keyed_answer_explanation: It helps limit neck strain, especially in rear impacts.
questions.baseline_gap_reason: Head-restraint adjustment is mentioned without explaining neck protection or rear-impact head movement.
questions.required_teaching_claim: Explain head-restraint purpose and head/neck movement in a collision.
questions.source_route: R-HEADREST.

questions.question_prompt: Why are rear-facing restraints recommended for young children?
questions.keyed_answer: They support the head and neck and distribute crash forces.
questions.keyed_answer_explanation: A young child's relatively heavy head and vulnerable neck need suitable support.
questions.baseline_gap_reason: Rear-facing seats are recommended without explaining young children’s head/neck support and crash-force distribution.
questions.required_teaching_claim: Explain rear-facing child-seat support and distribution of collision forces.
questions.source_route: R-CHILD.

questions.question_prompt: The steering wheel vibrates at certain speeds. Which fault is a possible cause?

questions.question_prompt: You fit a temporary spare wheel after a puncture. What should guide its use?

questions.question_prompt: How do you use the three-second following-distance guideline?
